name: Tessera Corponation Laminar Ghost Chassis
description:
The Laminar Ghost Chassis is Tessera Corponation's flagship stealth suit — a full-body garment system that combines passive thermal baffling, acoustic dampening laminate, and a dynamic optical surface layer into a unified platform. The outer surface is composed of Tessera's proprietary Fold-Reactive polymer, which samples ambient light from micro-aperture sensors distributed across the suit and re-emits it through a micro-LED matrix on the opposing surface, creating a near-real-time visual camouflage effect that is effective against human observers and most standard optical surveillance systems at ranges beyond four meters. The effect degrades noticeably at close range and breaks down entirely under ultraviolet or multispectral scanning.

Beneath the optical layer, the Ghost Chassis incorporates a passive thermal baffling membrane that suppresses the wearer's infrared signature to approximately ambient temperature within 90 seconds of activation, and an acoustic dampening laminate that reduces movement noise to below 15 decibels at normal walking pace. The suit is powered by a distributed micro-cell array woven through the lining, providing up to six hours of full active operation before requiring recharge. Tessera has positioned the Ghost Chassis as an intelligence-gathering and infiltration tool rather than a combat platform — the underlying armor protection is modest, rated for light fragmentation and minimal ballistic resistance.

The Ghost Chassis is tightly controlled by Tessera, sold exclusively through authorized intelligence-sector procurement channels and issued under strict end-user licensing agreements. Despite this, several units have surfaced in the hands of corporate espionage teams, high-end criminal organizations, and at least one documented case involving a GLMZ investigative journalist who used one to document a restricted Tessera research facility — an incident that resulted in significant legal action and the journalist's disappearance.

specifications.coverage: Full body including hood and gloves
specifications.optical_camouflage_failure_modes: UV light, multispectral scanning, ranges under 4m

tactical_use: The Ghost Chassis is optimized for reconnaissance, infiltration, and exfiltration in controlled environments. Operators are trained to move slowly and deliberately — rapid movement creates artifacts in the optical layer that are detectable even at range. The suit is most effective in low-light conditions where the optical camouflage is supplemented by natural shadow. Standard counter-tactics include UV flood lighting, multispectral scanning sweeps, and acoustic sensors below the suit's dampening threshold.
cultural_context: The Ghost Chassis exists in a space of near-mythological status in GLMZ's intelligence and criminal communities. Its rarity and the legal risk of possessing one make it a symbol of extreme capability and resource. Tessera's aggressive enforcement of end-user agreements — including rumored remote-deactivation and self-destruct capabilities built into the power array — means that owning one outside of sanctioned channels is understood to be a direct confrontation with the corporation. Some operators refer to unsanctioned Ghost Chassis units as 'orphans,' acknowledging their precarious status.
known_users: Unknown — recovered unit, identity of operator undetermined
Sera Nacht (alias — wanted by Tessera for unauthorized possession)
story_hooks: A Ghost Chassis has been recovered from a crime scene where the wearer was killed — Tessera's recovery team arrived before law enforcement and removed it, but the players witnessed the exchange.
Tessera has remotely deactivated a Ghost Chassis while the operator was in the middle of a deep-cover infiltration — the timing suggests an inside leak, and the operator is now trapped.
A fence is offering a Ghost Chassis at a price that is suspiciously low — the unit may have been allowed to 'escape' Tessera's supply chain as bait for identifying unauthorized buyers.

The investigative journalist who used a Ghost Chassis to document a Tessera facility left encrypted footage that only surfaces when the suit's power array is activated — the suit is the key, and multiple parties want it.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting full-body suit that appears to shimmer and shift with surrounding environment. The outer surface has an almost liquid quality — constantly rippling with reflected light patterns that make it difficult to focus on. Under static lighting, reveals a dense geometric lattice of micro-apertures and recessed micro-LED points across every surface. The hood covers the entire head with a translucent smart-fabric faceplate that allows vision outward while maintaining the camouflage effect. Gloves extend to mid-forearm with articulated finger design.
physical_description.dimensions: Full-body coverage; approximately 175–190 cm tall when worn, fitted close to human form without bulk
physical_description.weight_description: 6.1 kg distributed evenly — handheld when folded, barely noticeable when worn due to advanced load distribution
physical_description.primary_material: Tessera proprietary Fold-Reactive polymer outer layer; acoustic dampening laminate mid-layer; passive thermal baffle membrane; distributed micro-cell power grid woven into synthetic substrate lining
physical_description.finish: Outer surface: iridescent, semi-matte with micro-texture; appears to shift and flow with ambient light. Sensor apertures create subtle shadow patterns across the suit. Seams and panel lines barely visible, integrated seamlessly into the overall camouflage matrix.
physical_description.color_scheme: Base color shifts depending on environment — predominantly charcoal-grey with hints of silver and deep blue in the micro-LED array. When active, displays real-time color sampling of surroundings, creating an ever-changing adaptive palette.
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal visible controls: small haptic touch panel on left wrist with raised Tessera logo marker; soft-glow status indicator strip along right hip (green/amber/red for power states); embedded micro-ports at sternum (power coupling, sealed with diamond-polymer caps); internal heads-up display projection integrated into hood faceplate
distinctive_features: Constantly rippling micro-LED surface creates hypnotic, almost liquid appearance when illuminated
Micro-aperture sensor grid visible as subtle shadow pattern across entire suit
Smart-fabric hood faceplate maintains camouflage effect while allowing wearer vision
Barely perceptible seam work — appears almost organic rather than constructed
Tessera's proprietary geometric quilting pattern visible under close inspection
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Small raised Tessera Corporation logo on left wrist (chrome inlay); regulatory stamp on right shoulder blade (barely visible, intended for authorized personnel only); serialized micro-etch on sternum power coupling, obscured by design
physical_description.condition_typical: When powered and active: appears to shimmer and shift as it samples and re-emits ambient light — hypnotic, slightly unsettling to observe directly. When dormant: appears as a high-end tactical bodysuit with visible sensor grid and LED matrix, dark grey-blue. Even at rest, the micro-apertures and recessed diodes create subtle depth and movement.

Geometric sensor apertures create shadow-patterns across the material. One gloved hand is visible adjusting the left wrist control panel, showing the faint Tessera logo.
